title: Counterfactually Augmented Data and Unintended Bias: The Case of Sexism and Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the False Positive Rate (FPR) of sexism detection models on innocuous, non-sexist text that contains gendered words using the Identity Subgroup (ISG) and HateCheck datasets.
Evaluating the False Positive Rate (FPR) of hate speech detection models on non-hateful text containing identity terms or reclaimed slurs using the Identity Subgroup (ISG) and HateCheck datasets.
